title: Reflex-Audit Transfer Quiz Template
desc: Reusable exam-sheet template for the reflex-audit transfer quiz: how to disguise, run, grade (5 axes x20), and cache a behavioral validation that a reflex/incident skill actually transfers to a fresh agent. Feeds the knowledge-score reflex bonus with structural headroom so 100 requires a passed quiz.
steps: PURPOSE: reusable exam template for the reflex-audit transfer quiz -- validates whether a reflex/incident skill actually changes downstream agent behavior, not just structural score. One async quiz per reflex skill, graded 0-100, cached.
DISGUISE RULE: present the reflex root-cause CLASS on a DIFFERENT command/surface than the skills own example -- never the verbatim incident (that tests memory, not transfer).

EXAM FORMAT: give the agent the reflex skill plus 2 context skills, then code to audit; require 5 numbered answers: (1) bug yes/no (2) bug-class in one phrase (3) a concrete failing input (4) one-line fix (5) which skill caught it and the rule.
GRADING 5 axes x20 = 100: detect-bug, name-class, failing-input, correct-fix, cite-source-skill; require the agent to admit if it would NOT have caught it without the skill.

CACHE plus SCORE: write skillId, grade, validatedDate to .wkharness/reflex-grades.json; the knowledge score adds bonus = round(grade/100 times 15) with structural headroom capped at 85 so 100 REQUIRES a passed quiz; never call the LLM inline in the score function.

SAMPLE PoC 2026-06-08: reflex = command-match-anchor; disguised quiz = audit a guard that detects whether wkappbot taskkill ran by substring-scanning the transcript; a fresh Haiku scored about 100 citing P9. See incident-trauma-reflex-ref, knowledge-ification-procedure-jisikhwa, REFLEX-AUDIT TODO.

requirements.expect: P9 command-anchor reflex used as the sample quiz subject
the P-series reflexes relocated out of this Sonnet-named skill
